Lady '''Valera Prosnarin''' was one of the four founders of [[Ghealdan]].

==History==
In the year {{Fy|1109}}, Lady Valera, along with Lord [[Kirin Almeyda]], Lord [[Cynric Talvaen]] and Lady [[Iona Ashmar]] founded the kingdom of Ghealdan. They joined their strong Houses together, Lord Kirin became King Kirin and the other three formed a Royal Crown Council ([[Crown High Council]]), which had considerable power, as well as the choose the ruler and which later admitted still more noble Houses to membership.{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Ghealdan}}
